parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A primary left-click button made of ABS plastic, located on the top front of the mouse.
parts.Functional_description: Used for primary selection and clicking actions in computer operations.
parts.Movement_description: Moves vertically downward when pressed and returns via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A right-click button made of ABS plastic, positioned adjacent to the left button.
parts.Functional_description: Used for secondary actions such as context menus or alternate commands.
parts.Movement_description: Moves vertically downward when pressed and returns via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small middle button located behind the scroll wheel, made of ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: Used for additional functions such as DPI adjustment or mode switching.
parts.Movement_description: Moves vertically downward when pressed and returns via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A rubberized scroll wheel located between the left and right buttons.
parts.Functional_description: Used for scrolling through pages or lists and can also be clicked for middle-click actions.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates around its horizontal axis and can be pressed vertically.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A side button located on the left side of the mouse body, made of ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: Typically used for forward navigation or custom functions in software.
parts.Movement_description: Moves inward when pressed and returns via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A side button located on the left side of the mouse body, made of ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: Typically used for backward navigation or custom functions in software.
parts.Movement_description: Moves inward when pressed and returns via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: An additional top or side button made of ABS plastic, used for auxiliary functions.
parts.Functional_description: Can be programmed for specific tasks such as macro execution or sensitivity control.
parts.Movement_description: Moves vertically or inward when pressed and returns via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body shell of the mouse made of ABS plastic, providing structure and housing internal components.
parts.Functional_description: Supports all other parts, provides ergonomic shape for hand placement, and houses electronic components.
parts.Movement_description: Does not move; serves as the fixed structural base of the mouse.
